{{Top|leg}}
'''Kroyn'Tal''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] located on the planet of [[Coyn]]. The [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[Kroyn'Tais]] or "Warriorland" was located in this city as well. Kroyn'Tal also contained the main [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] base for the planet as well, although the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] presence in the system was minimal.
